baseline_reuse: Hash-locked identical 512-state unadapted outputs from V2; no repeated GPU baseline generation.
reason: The V3 labeled editor fixture at 1e-3 rose in q25 loss and both models hit the 96-token cutoff on all 64 cases. It did not test stable serialization. V4 uses a simpler two-action diagnostic and the lower 3e-4 rate that previously yielded finite, terminated outputs. No development or held-out adaptation result has been seen.

v4_fixture.gate: At least one exact no-edit and one exact deletion, and a valid terminated response for each action. This is an implementation check, not a performance threshold.
v4_fixture.prompt: Two literal N/R action examples, then an alternating no_edit or delete action cue and a case index; response includes newline and EOS.
v4_fixture.source: disposable synthetic family 99; never used as adaptation quality evidence
